title: Detector infrastructure: §8.1 contract, read-only context, total criterion→detector registry
rationale: trellis-5963 builds src/detectors/ as 3 core modules + barrel. types.ts is the SPEC §8.1 contract verbatim (DetectionContext, DetectorResult{numerator 0|1|null, denominator literal 1, naKind?, rationale}, Detector) plus a zod detectorResultSchema and pass/fail/notApplicable/noDetector constructors that clamp rationale to MAX_RATIONALE and enforce the numerator↔naKind biconditional. NaKind/MAX_RATIONALE are re-exported from scoring so detector + scorecard share one §3.2/§6.2 vocabulary (detectors depends on scoring; no cycle). context.ts createDetectionContext roots readFile/glob/run at repoPath/app.path, refuses to escape repo (contain() via path.relative), and run() NEVER throws — missing tool→exit 127, timeout→timedOut+kill — so detectors map failures to noDetector() not crashes. No write surface by construction = read-only mandate. registry.ts DetectorRegistry.resolve is TOTAL: per-language adapter (first app-language match wins) > common > no-detector stub; unbound or no-adapter never crashes, never false-passes. BINDINGS is empty until detector issues (d600/299e/3d67/89b4/7f70) populate it; the no-detector fallback already satisfies 'covers all 70 deterministic ids'. Tests cross-check registry keys ⊆ deterministic rubric ids and that all 70 resolve to schema-valid results.
